title: Declaration on the Importance and Value of Universal Museums
author: Directors of the signatory museums

notes.text: This source is the declaration circulated in December 2002 and signed collectively by the directors of the museums listed in the document. ICOM's catalogue (https://icom.museum/en/ressource/declaration-on-the-importance-and-value-of-universal-museums/) identifies a 2004 ICOM periodical publication of the declaration (page 4); that catalogue record is used here to distinguish the later publication date, not registered as a second source. ICOM's publication does not establish its endorsement. The declaration is a historical institutional argument and should not be presented as the current position of ICOM or any signatory without separate evidence. No local copy is registered because redistribution rights for a preserved copy were not established during review. The PDF host is the Internet Archive; the original declaration's issuing context and the PDF's current host are distinct.
